newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Act's Prebble says NZ First having genuine trouble.
newsitem.headline: Act's Prebble says NZ First having genuine trouble.

text.p: Act New Zealand leader Richard Prebble said on Tuesday the New Zealand First Party appeared to be in serious trouble as its members met to choose a coalition partner.
"I think that New Zealand First is in genuine troubles. I don't think they are just grandstanding now," Prebble told TVNZ journalist Paul Holmes.

"Many of them have never made a decision before in their lives. As a caucus, the only decision they ever made together before was who is buying the beer. Now they've suddenly got to form a government, and they are finding it a bit difficult," he

"I was told by a New Zealand First MP that he hadn't been informed by Winston (Peters) at all what was going on, what the deals were, so indeed the Alliance may have seen the agreement with Labour before the New Zealand First MPs.
"That's because of Mr Peters' extraordinarily secretive style, and of course it's now catching up with him," Prebble said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
